title: 2p2d - GenStone
text:
Can't Decide on a Color? We'll Bring Our Showroom to You!
Get Two Full-Size Panels Delivered to Your Door in Just Two Days!

Choosing the perfect color online can be tough. That’s why we’re making it easy to see, feel, and test GenStone in your own space! Select any two stone or brick panels, and we’ll ship them to you in two days. It’s the best way to confidently choose the perfect style for your home transformation.

Get Your Panels Now

See the Transformation in 3 Simple Steps

Getting started with your GenStone project has never been easier! Our sample program is designed to give you total confidence in your color choice.

- Pick Your Panels: Choose any two stone or brick panels from our collection. Mix and match to see what looks best!

- Get Them Fast: We’ll deliver your full-size panels directly to your door in just two days.

- Choose with Confidence: Once you’ve decided on your favorite color, we’ll credit the cost of the samples toward your full project order. It’s a completely risk-free way to get started!

Why Try Before You Buy?

Forget tiny 12×12 samples. Experience the real deal and see exactly how GenStone will look and feel on your wall.

- Full-Size Panels : Get a true sense of scale and color variation with large panels. Our stone panels are 3.20 sqft and our brick panels are 1.875 sqft.

- Feel the Quality: Experience the authentic texture, weight, and durability of GenStone firsthand. You’ll see just how simple our panels are to handle and install.

- A No-Risk Solution: We’re so sure you’ll love it that we’ll credit the cost of your chosen sample panels toward your final project purchase. You have nothing to lose!

Visualize It Before You Get It
Snap Photo • Upload • See GenStone Instantly

Want to see how our colors will look on your home right now? Use our amazing visualizer tool! Just upload a photo of your project space, interior or exterior and you can instantly preview every GenStone color. It’s the perfect first step before ordering your panels!

See It On Your Home

Frequently Asked Questions
We're Here to Help! Connect with a Project Coordinator

Can I Keep My Full Panel Samples?

Yes! We encourage customers to purchase full panel samples for many reasons including the panel is ready to be used in your project. You can either keep or return the color you do not choose, but the refund is only issued for the color selected as part of the 2 Panels in 2 Days sample program.

Kenneth Stauffer

Senior Project Coordinator / Training Supervisor

How Long Does it Take to Get My Sample Credit?

The request for credit is sent to our accounting team as soon as you place your full GenStone order, just make sure to remind your Project Coordinator! The refund is usually issued within one business day.

How Much is the 2 Panels 2 Days Program?

Typically, purchasing two panels + expedited 2 day air shipping costs well over $100, but to make your color decision easier we ship 2 full size panels to your door for just $99 AND when you purchase the GenStone you need for your project we will credit you for the cost of the color you select making the first panel for your project FREE.

Ellie Peretz

Assistant Manager

Should I Buy Samples or Full Panel Samples

We encourage our customers to purchase full panel samples, they do cost a bit more but seeing one full panel in person allows you to evaluate the full color profile as it appears throughout the panel and see how large the panels actually are. The 12″ x 12″ samples are good if you are simply looking to see how durable GenStone is in addition to how lightweight and easy to cut GenStone is.

Rob Dean

Senior Project Coordinator
